// Routes used by the deeplink command tests.
final router = GoRouter(
  routes: [
    GoRoute(
      path: '/',
      name: 'home',
      builder: (context, state) => const HomePage(),
      routes: [
        GoRoute(
          path: 'users/:id',
          name: 'user',
          builder: (context, state) => UserPage(id: state.pathParameters['id']!),
          routes: [
            GoRoute(path: 'posts/:postId', name: 'post', builder: _post),
          ],
        ),
      ],
    ),
    StatefulShellRoute.indexedStack(
      builder: (context, state, shell) => Shell(shell: shell),
      branches: [
        StatefulShellBranch(routes: [
          GoRoute(path: '/feed', name: 'feed', builder: _feed),
        ]),
        StatefulShellBranch(routes: <RouteBase>[
          GoRoute(path: "/settings", builder: _settings), /* GoRoute(path: '/hidden') */
        ]),
      ],
    ),
    GoRoute(path: '/search', name: 'search', redirect: (_, s) => '/x/$s'),
    GoRoute(path: '/dynamic/$prefix', name: 'skipped'),
  ],
);

@TypedGoRoute<AboutRoute>(path: '/about', routes: [TypedGoRoute<TeamRoute>(path: 'team')])
class AboutRoute extends GoRouteData {}
